overview: droid-term is a portable setup script that bootstraps a fully functional, productive development environment inside a standard Android terminal without requiring root access. It is built specifically for software developers who need to review code, run scripts, or manage git repositories directly from their mobile device.
usecases: Quickly reviewing and hot-fixing a pull request from your phone while away from your primary workstation.
Running local command-line scripts, Node.js tools, or Python utilities during your commute.
Managing remote servers via SSH with your preferred dotfiles, shell shortcuts, and SSH keys already configured.
howto: Download the appbundle and open your preferred Android terminal emulator.
Run the one-command environment check to verify system compatibility.
Execute the portable setup script to automatically install core developer tools and configure your shell.

faq.q: Do I need to root my Android device to use this?
faq.a: No, droid-term runs entirely within user space and requires zero root privileges or dangerous system modifications.

faq.q: How does this differ from manually installing packages in Termux?
faq.a: It automates the tedious bootstrapping process, instantly configuring a cohesive, productive developer environment with a single command instead of hours of manual package management.
